crossRefs.note: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great…
For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces; for the man Mordecai…
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
translations.bsb: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.
translations.kjv: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
translations.asv: And Jehovah gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
